description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver subclass that handles the result of a pin shortcut request in an Android application.

classes.name: RequestPinShortcutResultReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles the result of a shortcut pinning request, displaying a toast message when triggered.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Called when the BroadcastReceiver is triggered; displays a toast indicating the result was received.
